name: Riftseeker’s Sanctum: Outer Ring
summary: The fortified perimeter of Riftseeker’s Sanctum, where Muramite forces clash with Riftseeker wardens amid planar containment structures.
description: The Outer Ring is the defensive boundary of Riftseeker’s Sanctum. Massive stone buttresses, planar containment pylons, and fortified walkways encircle the inner chambers. Muramite forces maintain a tenuous foothold here, attempting to breach deeper into the Sanctum. Riftseekers patrol the ring to repel intruders and stabilize planar leaks. Discord manifestations erupt unpredictably from containment failures, turning the Outer Ring into a chaotic battleground of discipline, intrusion, and planar instability.
